verdict.rationale: Casium's organization page says "No RFE or assessment fees." That implies its attorneys handle RFE responses as part of the engagement rather than billing them separately. A dedicated attorney and case team signs every filing, which supports that reading. Beyond this one line, nothing describes how RFE response work is done. Missing for 10: any mention of NOID handling, a documented RFE response process or examples, whether individual/founder plans also include RFE work, and independent corroboration.
